description: This dataset documents boulder deposits resulting from the Sucha Woda flood event on July 24, 2018. It records measurements from eleven distinct sites, capturing geographic coordinates and elevation data to define the spatial context. The core data includes counts of tree trunks and detailed diameter measurements for up to twenty-five boulders at each location. These geological observations serve as critical evidence for analyzing flood dynamics and sediment transport. Researchers can utilize this information to study the relationship between flow energy and boulder size, aiding in hazard assessment and understanding the geomorphological impacts of extreme flood events in mountainous regions.
